title: ScapConfigurationSetting
description: SCAP-sourced archetype — configuration setting identification per Common Configuration Enumeration (CCE). Each CCE entry uniquely identifies a configuration guidance statement, enabling correlation of security configuration guidance across multiple sources (CIS Benchmarks, DISA STIGs, NIST 800-53). Rootless — cross-cutting identification dimension applicable to any configurable subject. Source: NIST CCE List, NIST SP 800-126 r3 (SCAP 1.3).

cceId.description: CCE unique identifier. Format: CCE-{digits}-{check digit} (e.g., CCE-80214-3). Each CCE ID uniquely identifies a single configuration guidance statement. Source: NIST CCE specification.

settingDescription.description: Human-readable description of the configuration issue this CCE identifies (e.g., 'The SSH PermitRootLogin setting should be disabled'). Source: CCE List description field.

platform.description: CPE URI identifying the technology platform to which this configuration setting applies (e.g., 'cpe:2.3:o:redhat:enterprise_linux:8:*:*:*:*:*:*:*'). Cross-references ScapPlatformIdentifier. Source: CCE List platform field.

technicalMechanism.description: Implementation method for checking or setting this configuration (e.g., 'sshd_config file', 'Windows Registry HKLM\...', 'sysctl kernel parameter', 'Group Policy Object'). Source: CCE List technical mechanism field.

parameters.description: Available values or options for this configuration setting (e.g., 'yes/no', 'enabled/disabled', numeric range). Source: CCE List parameters field.

controlReferences.description: Control framework references that cite this configuration setting (e.g., 'CIS Controls v8 Safeguard 5.2', 'NIST SP 800-53 CM-6'). This property documents the cross-framework traceability that CCE natively provides. Source: CCE List references field.
